name: Fabio Restrepo
biography: Fabio Iván Restrepo Cifuentes (Apía, Risaralda; August 15, 1959-Medellín, Antioquia; February 13, 2022) was a Colombian film and television actor, recognized mainly for playing Gerardo in Víctor Gaviria's film Sumas y restas and for his extensive career in Colombian film and television.
